name: hr-management-app
description: HR Management System - Full Stack Web Application

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.verify: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
